review.imagery: Root reviewed all forty-seven original PDF pages, eighteen whole selected drawing and context sheets, all twenty-two enlarged numerical schedules, both factsheets, thirteen native resources and both own website contacts. Twelve distinct native concepts, three corroborated own-page concepts and one own construction photograph are retained. The repeated aerial crop, corporate imagery and generic stock amenities are excluded. Capture date is unavailable. The current marker only identifies Masdar City and is excluded as a project-specific pin. All cluster keys, duplex and townhouse levels, source notices and measurement conflicts remain intact.
review.floorPlans: All selected whole original sheets, complete numerical schedules, source notices and every drawn level visually reviewed by root. Measurement and source-edition conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Whole original map and factsheets reviewed. Travel modes retain source scope. Unreliable phase markers are excluded. Missing coordinates use project-name directions.
review.provenance: Fresh ordinary GET receipts retain source URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. All complete selected pages, native resources and visible numerical panels have been root reviewed. Independent source values and delivered lossless pixels must pass before browser verification. Generic community coordinates are excluded as a project pin.
